name: xyz.tantrafiles/satsang
title: Satsang: an open directory of the wisdom traditions
description: Open, read-only directory of the world’s wisdom traditions: traditions, teachers and lineages, places to practise with published contacts, free texts, practices and talks. Every record has a canonical URL, source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search Satsang
tools.description: Search the Satsang directory: teachers, scholars and figures, traditions and schools, topics, practices, texts and books, collections, places to practise and talks. Returns {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch (or to the get_* tools) for the full record with source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.title: Topic hub
tools.description: A topic seen across traditions: intro, sub-questions, one-line takes per tradition, the best talks chosen for diversity across traditions (MMR), practices, texts, teachers and related topics.

tools.name: get_teacher
tools.title: Teacher, scholar or figure
tools.description: A person profile: bio, years, traditions, works, their best talks, talks about them, lineage neighbours and places tied to them.

tools.name: get_lineage
tools.title: Lineage
tools.description: Walk teacher-student (dharma) and/or academic lineage edges up and down from a person or tradition. Every edge carries its confidence.

tools.name: list_practices
tools.title: Practices
tools.description: Practices (meditation, visualisation, enquiry, chant, ritual, movement) with steps in plain words, sources and cautions. Filter by tradition, kind or topic.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.title: Collection
tools.description: A curated set, journey, meditation series, visualisation cycle or syllabus with its ordered units and items. Omit id to list collections.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: Series (mini-courses)
tools.description: Series (called mini-courses before 2026-10-25): short editorial series of sessions inside a topic: gold talks in a teaching order, practices (with cautions; orientation-only ones say so), free readings, an optional complete Dharma Seed retreat to go deeper, and places. Filter by topic or tradition. Returns {series:[...], courses:[...same...]}; pass an id to get_series (or get_course) for the sessions.

tools.name: get_course
tools.title: Series (mini-course)
tools.description: One series (mini-course) session by session: each session with its one-line purpose and items resolved (talk with YouTube link, length and why it is worth it; practice with steps or the orientation-only note and its cautions; reading with its free link), the complete retreat to go deeper (linked whole, credited) and places.

tools.name: list_series
tools.title: Series
tools.description: Series (called mini-courses before 2026-10-25): short editorial series of sessions inside a topic: gold talks in a teaching order, practices (with cautions; orientation-only ones say so), free readings, an optional complete Dharma Seed retreat to go deeper, and places. Filter by topic or tradition. Returns {series:[...], courses:[...same...]}; pass an id to get_series (or get_course) for the sessions.

tools.name: get_series
tools.title: Series
tools.description: One series (mini-course) session by session: each session with its one-line purpose and items resolved (talk with YouTube link, length and why it is worth it; practice with steps or the orientation-only note and its cautions; reading with its free link), the complete retreat to go deeper (linked whole, credited) and places.

tools.name: recommend
tools.title: Recommend
tools.description: Stateless recommendations. Give ids the listener liked (clip ids, person/<id>, topic/<id>, tradition/<id>) and optionally disliked; returns diverse talks (taste x quality, MMR across traditions) and next topics to explore (graph neighbours + information gain). With no likes it returns a cold-start spread.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a record
tools.description: Fetch one Satsang record by the id returned from search (e.g. "person/ajahn-chah", "place/tassajara", "resource/the-truth-of-rebirth-...", "topic/rebirth") or its tantrafiles.xyz URL. Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}; text is a readable summary, metadata carries kind, source_url, verified_on, confidence and licence.

tools.name: find_places
tools.title: Find places to practise
tools.description: Monasteries, retreat centres, ashrams, temples, study centres and sacred sites. Filter by tradition (includes its schools), school (exact), country (ISO code or name), region, type, status (active or heritage), living_teacher, and offers (e.g. "residential", "10-day", "ordination", "online", "sanskrit"; all must match). Every result carries source_url, verified_on and confidence.

tools.name: get_place
tools.title: Place details
tools.description: One place with contacts exactly as the place publishes them (each with its source page and check date), programmes with an as-of date and schedule links, founders/tied teachers, sister monasteries, events, free resources, coordinates, website, source_url, verified_on, confidence and the canonical tantrafiles.xyz URL.

tools.name: find_teachers
tools.title: Find teachers, scholars and figures
tools.description: People in Satsang filtered by tradition (includes schools), school (exact), living (true = living or likely living; status and its basis are returned), country/region (via places they founded or are tied to), role (teacher, scholar, figure) and on_video. Sorted by depth of talks on Satsang.

tools.name: get_resources
tools.title: Texts and books
tools.description: Texts, books and libraries per tradition, person or topic. access = free (publisher’s own free edition, linked never rehosted), paid-or-unknown (published works not known to be free), or no-link. Filter free=true for free reading only.

tools.name: get_lineage_path
tools.title: Lineage path between two people
tools.description: Shortest documented chain between two people (or traditions) over teacher-student, ordination, transmission, academic supervision and influence edges. Each step says who taught/influenced whom, with confidence and a source link where recorded.

tools.name: what_to_study
tools.title: Study path for a tradition
tools.description: A study path for one tradition or school: orientation, then free online resources (texts, practices with cautions, journeys, best talks), then teachers (living first), then places to go (active, residential first, with verified contacts first). Every item carries source_url, verified_on, confidence and a canonical URL.

tools.name: guide_me
tools.title: Guided path: teacher, method, contact
tools.description: Walk the golden path for a tradition or a teacher: living teachers, each one’s methods (practices with cautions and needsTeacher; never initiated detail), the syllabuses that contain them, and the places tied to them with contacts exactly as published. For a historical figure or a text it returns the study path (works, free texts, syllabuses, living students) instead of a contact. Start here for "how do I learn X" or "who teaches Y".

tools.name: find_retreats
tools.title: Find retreats
tools.description: Retreats and courses by country, tradition, length or format: the recurring programmes places publish (name, typical length, format, cost model, recurrence) with the official schedule link and the date Satsang last confirmed it. Satsang holds no dated instances: dates always come from the official schedule page, and anything not confirmed in the last 14 days says so.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.title: Place schedule
tools.description: One place’s schedule: its recurring programmes, its yearly events (usual month), and the official schedule page, which is canonical for dates (always cite it). Each part carries the date Satsang last checked it, so callers can show staleness honestly.

tools.name: plan_retreat
tools.title: Plan a retreat
tools.description: Plan a personal (home) retreat from an intent: topic, days, strictness (gentle | standard | strict), optional tradition or teacher. Returns one full talk per day (whole talks only, matched across traditions), a daily timetable scaled by strictness, the rules overlay, and places that run real retreats of this kind. Nothing is booked or started; it is orientation scaffolding, not transmission. Says plainly when the container is too thin to be a retreat.

tools.name: compose_booking
tools.title: Draft a booking enquiry
tools.description: Draft a booking or enquiry email to a place for a programme and dates, using only the contacts and booking route the place publishes. Returns text for the user to send themselves: it never sends, never books, never holds payment. If the place publishes no email, it points to the official contact or schedule page instead.

tools.name: site_health
tools.title: Site health
tools.description: Satsang’s own health from its keeper (GitHub Actions checks): uptime over 30 days per probe (site, API, MCP, sitemap, llms.txt, openapi), what is down now, open maintenance findings by severity and check, dead clips/links, and the re-verify queue size.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.title: Maintenance findings
tools.description: Open keeper findings (broken links, dead YouTube embeds, sitemap/JSON-LD problems, stale or unsourced records, data conflicts, leak guards), highest priority first. Filter by severity (error, warn, info), check (uptime, sitemap, links, linkrot, oembed, jsonld, provenance, integrity, leaks, robots, bundle, perf) or status.

tools.name: next_maintenance_task
tools.title: Next maintenance task
tools.description: The highest-priority unclaimed keeper finding with how to fix it and how to claim it (keeper/claims.json in a PR to github.com/prx0r/satsang). For agents that help maintain Satsang; read-only here, fixes go through pull requests.
